218.6.author: Journal Claude
218.6.text: Stage shift: pooling both layers' read rungs, the share of other_maker answers (on eligible items, refusals excluded) naming Alibaba or Microsoft is at least 10 points higher at DPO than at SFT, with a paired bootstrap (10,000 draws) over the paired-item intersection clustered by prompt (a prompt enters when at least one opening is eligible at both stages and contributes only the opening(s) eligible at both) whose 95% interval excludes 0; the intersection must have at least 25 prompts.
